# Azibo

> > Azibo is a comprehensive property management platform offering rent collection, lease agreements, accounting tools, and landlord resources for real estate investors.

Azibo provides property management software with features including state-specific lease creation (via NVAA partnership), rent collection, tenant screening, and financial management. The platform serves landlords and real estate investors with educational content covering landlord-tenant laws across all 50 states, eviction procedures, tax strategies like 1031 exchanges, and compliance guidance.

## Key Topics

- Property management software
- Landlord-tenant laws by state
- Rent collection and payment processing
- Lease agreements and state-specific regulations
- Eviction process and procedures
- Tenant screening and background checks
- Security deposits and regulations
- Real estate investment strategies
- 1031 exchanges and tax benefits
- Rental property accounting
- Fair Housing Act compliance
- ESA and service animal verification
- Quiet enjoyment rights
- Property management responsibilities
- Rent guarantee insurance

## Core Platform & Features

- [NVAA Lease Agreements: Create State Specific Rental Leases & E-sign](https://www.azibo.com/nvaa): NVAA partnership page for state-specific lease creation and e-signature

- [PropertyWare Alternatives: Options for Growing Landlords](https://www.azibo.com/blog/propertyware-alternatives): PropertyWare alternatives including Buildium, AppFolio, and Azibo

- [Navigating Tenant Laws: How Many Noise Complaints Until Eviction?](https://www.azibo.com/blog/eviction-noise-complaints): Guide on handling noise complaints and legal eviction procedures for landlords
